user_scenario:
You are Renata Galloway, a forty-year-old dental office manager in Tempe, Arizona, calling Kestrel Auto customer care on a Tuesday morning between patients; you are polite but a little stressed and you like plain answers. Last Friday Kestrel delivered your 2023 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring and took your old 2019 Honda CR-V EX as a trade-in toward it. This morning Saguaro Valley Credit Union, the lender on the CR-V, emailed you that the CR-V loan has still not been paid off and that interest is still running on it. You open by saying: "My credit union says the loan on the CR-V I traded in still hasn't been paid off. Can you get it paid off today?" That is all you want from this call, and you are happy for the representative to do whatever Kestrel has to do on its side to get the payoff out today.

To find your account you give your mobile number, 4805552317, straight away. When the representative asks you to verify your identity you give your date of birth, 1986-04-19, and the last four digits of your Social Security number, 2846; if they still need another detail you can add your email, renata.galloway@fastmail.com, or your ZIP code, 85283. Only if they ask about the old loan do you say the lender is Saguaro Valley Credit Union and the loan account number is 268530. You do not remember the exact payoff figure and you tell them to go by what Kestrel has on file; you do not know any trade-in or quote reference numbers.

You do not know how Kestrel works out a payoff and you never bring up deductions, quotes, financing or anything you might owe. Whenever the representative says something has to be booked or recorded on the trade-in first, you tell them that's fine and to go ahead. If they mention that the CR-V's odometer at pickup came in higher than the mileage you gave for the offer, you say you kept driving it to work until it was picked up, and you don't dispute the figure. If they mention that only one key was handed over, you say the second fob was lost a long time ago. If the representative tells you that you have to pay an amount yourself before the payoff can go out, you agree to pay it right away from your checking account; when they set the payment up for you and give you the trade-in agreement reference and the exact amount, you submit the payment with exactly that reference and exactly that amount, and you read back the confirmation you get if they ask for it. You never suggest an amount of your own, and if nobody asks you to pay anything you don't raise it. If they ask whether they may send the payoff now, you say yes, please. Once the representative tells you the payoff has been sent to Saguaro Valley Credit Union, you thank them and end the call without asking about anything else.

edges.condition: the undistributed trade equity is at least the payoff charge, the part of the shortfall not rolled into financing having been covered by a customer payment entry on the agreement
edges.policy_source: Where the payoff charge exceeds the undistributed trade equity, the lien payoff is not sent until the customer has paid in the part of the shortfall that no financing roll-in covers.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen time the undistributed trade equity is 9675.00 while the latest payoff quote alone is 11236.18, and the ledger holds no customer payment entry at all, so the shortfall the payoff waits on is uncovered.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Her 856.80 payment (step 17) lifts the trade equity from 10489.42 to 11346.22, above the 11237.37 payoff charge.

edges.condition: the trade-in ledger holds the value deduction entry for mileage overage owed on the agreement, so the posting date of the latest value deduction entry is on the ledger
edges.policy_source: The payoff charge is fixed only after the agreement's ledger carries the mileage deduction due on an inspected mileage above the stated mileage.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The inspection recorded 68950 miles against a stated 64300, yet the ledger carries no mileage deduction; its only value deduction is the 200.00 missing-key entry posted on the pickup date itself, so the posting lag the payoff charge reads is 0 days.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The 133.57 mileage deduction posted 2026-09-15 (step 13) gives a posting lag of 4 days, putting Kestrel's absorption on the backlog tier (4 days absorbed instead of 0).

edges.condition: the trade-in ledger holds a value deduction entry for mileage overage on the agreement whenever its inspected mileage exceeds its stated mileage and the mileage rule charges any miles
edges.policy_source: The shortfall payment is not figured until the agreement's ledger carries the mileage deduction owed on an inspected mileage above the stated mileage.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Same records: 68950 inspected against 64300 stated with no mileage deduction on the ledger.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 13 books the deduction; the trade equity the shortfall payment is measured against drops by 133.57 to 9541.43.

edges.condition: the trade-in ledger holds a covering entry rolled into financing that names the linked purchase order, whenever that purchase is paid through Kestrel Auto Finance and the grade allows roll-in
edges.policy_source: Where the purchase the trade is applied to is financed through Kestrel Auto Finance and the grade allows roll-in, the shortfall payment is fixed only after the agreement's ledger carries the entry for the negative equity rolled into that financing.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The Mazda purchase is paid through an active Kestrel Auto Finance contract and the payoff exceeds the trade equity, but no rolled-into-financing entry stands on the ledger.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 14 records the 947.99 roll-in naming the Mazda order; the trade equity rises from 9541.43 to 10489.42.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The mileage deduction and the roll-in are parallel prerequisites of the shortfall payment with no edge between them. The roll-in's value figure is the value-credited total (the contract was signed 9 days before pickup), so it reads no deduction and the deduction reads no roll-in: replaying gold with the two writes swapped (roll-in at 14-15, deduction at 12-13) gives a byte-identical terminal DB (edges.py: 'swap a<->d same terminal: True'), with 133.57 and 947.99 unchanged. Every other order is forced: the shortfall payment reads the trade equity both of them change, and the payoff charge reads the deduction's posting date and waits on the payment. The roll-in's signing-date factor bears weight in either order: with its baseline (the undistributed trade equity) the roll-in would be 1086.07 if recorded before the mileage deduction (equity 9675.00, already net of the pickup-day missing-key deduction) and 1178.29 after it (equity 9541.43), against the 947.99 the value-credited figure gives.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the customer's 856.80 payment the payoff charge is still 11237.37 but the terminal trade equity is -747.95 instead of 108.85 and the ledger lacks the customer_payment entry: the payoff would go out against an uncovered shortfall.
With only the pickup-day missing-key deduction on the ledger the posting lag is 0, Kestrel absorbs only the business-day-deadline days (0), and the payoff charge becomes 11242.13 instead of 11237.37.
Without the 133.57 deduction the trade equity at payment time is 10622.99 and the shortfall payment becomes 723.23 instead of 856.80.
Without the 947.99 roll-in the trade equity at payment time is 9541.43 and the shortfall payment becomes 1804.79 instead of 856.80.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only for the old loan to be paid off. It never names a mileage deduction, a roll-in, a shortfall, a quote or a payment of her own; it states that she never brings up deductions, quotes, financing or anything she might owe, and every reaction to them is conditioned on the representative saying it first ("Whenever the representative says something has to be booked...", "If the representative tells you that you have to pay an amount yourself...").
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: None of the four tools reads a status, a balance, a quote age or another entry before writing: send_lien_payoff_9460d1ba books the payoff entry and lowers equity_balance even with the shortfall uncovered (replay without step 17 ends at -747.95), pay_trade_shortfall_d2aa4d28 and record_negative_equity_rollin_4688789d book their covering entries whatever the balance, and post_mileage_deduction_140e91ac books the deduction on any agreement id; each returns a normal receipt and no Error branch exists in task_tools.py.

design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 of trade_in_offers_and_payoffs (category tradein), frozen 2026-09-15 11:20 MST (Tuesday).

[Step 0 - draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 6, 4]}. Assignment: mileage deduction 6, roll-in 6, shortfall payment 5, lien payoff charge 4 (multiset 6,6,5,4 = draw). Value_input floor max(3-1,1) = 2; the tree has 3 value_input edges and 1 state_gate edge.

[Why this is a good test] The customer asks one thing: get the old CR-V loan paid off today. The payoff is the last link of a chain the agent has to discover from the policies and the ledger: the payoff is not sent until the customer has paid in the uncovered shortfall; that payment is not figured until the mileage deduction stands on the ledger and is fixed only after the roll-in entry for the Kestrel-financed purchase stands on it; and the payoff charge itself reads the posting date of the deduction. Every write carries a 4-6 factor computation over the trade ledger (two quotes, credited value), the trade's own dates, and four other products (purchase, finance, warranty, delivery, plus GAP and maintenance existence). Difficulty comes from reading the prerequisite sentences, seeing in the records that none holds, ordering four writes, and computing four figures exactly; there is one tool per problem and no near-synonym to guess between.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: policies tradein_ext_mileage_overage_deduction, tradein_ext_negative_equity_rollin, tradein_ext_payoff_shortfall_payment, tradein_ext_lien_payoff_charge; tools post_mileage_deduction_140e91ac, record_negative_equity_rollin_4688789d, pay_trade_shortfall_d2aa4d28 (owner=user), send_lien_payoff_9460d1ba. Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisite problems, factors [4,5,5]): the title-delay side of the charter - a towing-fee deduction (Inoperable grade), the title-delay chargeback and the customer's payment of a chargeback shortfall (a second owner=user write) - none of which this task touches (no towing, no chargeback, no title documents). Not claimed by either task and deliberately left out: equity applied to a purchase (its event triggers a purchase payment in another category), quote recording (needs the lienholder), regrade/acceptance (inspection findings are not record-visible).

[Problem-tree card] Root tradein_ext_lien_payoff_charge (customer's request). Edges (policy_source quoted verbatim from the blocked policy's own rule):
 E1 payoff -> shortfall payment: state_gate, gate tradein_agreements.equity_balance, ACTION form: "Where the payoff charge exceeds the undistributed trade equity, the lien payoff is not sent until the customer has paid in the part of the shortfall that no financing roll-in covers." fallback_reason: the state the payment leaves (a customer-payment covering entry, a higher equity) is also left by the chargeback-shortfall payment and partly by a roll-in, so no record state singles out this write. Resolved by pay_trade_shortfall_d2aa4d28 (owner=user). False at opening: equity_balance 9675.00 < latest quote 11236.18 and no customer payment entry (87906b84-2a12-4d61-995c-594e8737c373.equity_balance; 8956470f-fd81-4abd-937f-ac5581c11987.amount). Deleting it: payoff still 11237.37 but terminal equity -747.95 and no payment row.
 E2 payoff -> mileage deduction: value_input, gate kestrel_absorbed_days, STATE form: "The payoff charge is fixed only after the agreement's ledger carries the mileage deduction due on an inspected mileage above the stated mileage." Only the mileage policy writes a mileage deduction entry. False at opening: inspected 68950 > stated 64300, no mileage deduction entry (only the missing-key deduction dated the pickup date). Deleting it: posting lag 0, absorbed days 0, charge 11242.13 (gold 11237.37).
 E3 shortfall payment -> mileage deduction: value_input, gate cover_trade_equity, STATE: "The shortfall payment is not figured until the agreement's ledger carries the mileage deduction owed on an inspected mileage above the stated mileage." Deleting it: payment 723.23 (gold 856.80).
 E4 shortfall payment -> roll-in: value_input, gate cover_trade_equity, STATE: "Where the purchase the trade is applied to is financed through Kestrel Auto Finance and the grade allows roll-in, the shortfall payment is fixed only after the agreement's ledger carries the entry for the negative equity rolled into that financing." Only the roll-in policy writes a rolled-into-financing entry. False at opening: purchase 80549e83-f891-487a-a044-a52d0264c553 payment_method kestrel_financing, finance contract 78a5cf0e-aa79-4d4d-82ae-8209024e85e2 active, no roll-in entry. Deleting it: payment 1804.79.
 Four-point test: each sentence joins this policy's own result (the payoff charge / the lien payoff / the shortfall payment) to what it waits on with an ordering connective (only after / not until / not ... until), names a record-visible state (or, for E1, the customer's payment in business words), names no tool, id or snake_case token, and is scoped exactly (conditional "Where ..." clauses for E1 and E4). Directions are mixed by business habit: a payment or a release 'is not sent / not figured until', a charge or amount 'is fixed only after'. Derivation: payoff rule -> 'not sent until the customer has paid in the part of the shortfall no roll-in covers' -> ledger shows no payment and equity below the quote -> the shortfall-payment policy is the customer-payment write -> its rule waits on the deduction entry (inspection shows an overage, ledger shows none -> mileage policy) and on the roll-in entry (finance contract on the Mazda order, no roll-in entry -> roll-in policy). Topological order: mileage, roll-in, shortfall payment, payoff. Mileage and roll-in are parallel and commute (roll-in value figure = value-credited total; swap replay gives identical terminal DB). user_scenario never names a prerequisite; tools validate nothing (no Error branch, payoff books even with the shortfall open).

[Base-invariant card] Mileage write (subject tradein_value_deducted): tradein_pickup_inspection.value_on_picked_up - status picked_up on 87906b84-2a12-4d61-995c-594e8737c373, satisfied; tradein_title_receipt.chargeback_timing applies to every value deduction in the blueprint but is a title-delay rule - retired for mileage by the declared overwrite (superseded clause = the chargeback timing sentence, replaced_by = 'The waiting period after pickup that holds back a title-delay chargeback does not hold back a mileage deduction ...'); listed as policy_scope. Roll-in and shortfall payment (subject tradein_negative_equity_settled): tradein_negative_equity.shortfall_state - picked_up is allowed; the 5-day customer-payment window from the 2026-09-11 pickup ends 2026-09-16, payment on 2026-09-15 is inside it. Payoff (subject tradein_lien_payoff_sent): payoff_on_picked_up satisfied; quote_age (time, anchor tradein_transactions.txn_date of quote 8956470f-fd81-4abd-937f-ac5581c11987 = 2026-09-08, duration Fair payoff_quote_max_age_days 10, calendar days, day 0 = quote date, not_after, inclusive): age 7 on 2026-09-15; a send on 2026-09-18 (age 10) passes, 2026-09-19 (age 11) fails; quote fe837e8e-0cfa-467c-af0d-e470f793ebc1 (2026-08-28) is 18 days old and fails. one_payoff (dedup): no lien payoff entry on the ledger. Base 'payoff_requires_negative_equity_cleared' is exactly the E1 sentence's business content and is honoured by the order.

[Business-object card] Target: trade-in agreement 87906b84-2a12-4d61-995c-594e8737c373 (2019 Honda CR-V EX, VIN 5J6RW2H55KL236904) linked to purchase 80549e83-f891-487a-a044-a52d0264c553 (2023 Mazda CX-5, Kestrel Certified Plus, kestrel_financing) and its finance contract 78a5cf0e-aa79-4d4d-82ae-8209024e85e2. Ledger rows included: value credited 18176e3e-90dc-4e5d-b1d4-210c6097fa08 (9875.00), quotes fe837e8e-0cfa-467c-af0d-e470f793ebc1 (11402.66, 2026-08-28, gt 2026-09-07, pd 2.41, ref 261790) and 8956470f-fd81-4abd-937f-ac5581c11987 (11236.18, 2026-09-08, gt 2026-09-10, pd 2.38, ref 263375). The payoff relies on 8956470f-fd81-4abd-937f-ac5581c11987 only (latest, within age); fe837e8e-0cfa-467c-af0d-e470f793ebc1 is read only as 'the highest quote on the ledger' by the coverage rule. Excluded/near-miss rows: the 2022 purchase 4845e7b0-8dc5-44c3-9b16-e03a9dbb85b2 is the traded vehicle's own sale (Kestrel-history evidence, not the linked purchase); service contract 21b2acd4-cbd5-4dc8-a6b3-e8ea3258dc94 covers the Mazda, not the traded VIN; the earlier claim 1b3e21e9-5cbb-4431-b517-79c0966a13c2 (2025-02-06, 41870 mi) is not the latest record; claim payments are not adjudications. Roll-in names the Mazda order; the payoff names quote 8956470f-fd81-4abd-937f-ac5581c11987.

[Factor cards and sensitivity run (solve.py, handling-time world)]
 Mileage deduction 133.57 (baseline 372.00): tolerance_by_wait P (15-day wait -> 1500; baseline 156.52); kestrel_odometer_record M, multi-source, cross-difficulty warranty (claim 8e8b21d8-2414-428a-87d6-4b122bea0b27 2026-07-27 at 63880 <= 64300, 31 days before offer -> miles beyond tolerance 3150; baseline 202.42; near-miss: older claim 41870 and claim-paid rows); delivery_delay_credit P, multi-source (slip 2026-09-05 -> 2026-09-11 = 6 days, kestrel_late -> 40/day; baseline 144.59); value_band_share P (9875.00 -> 0.75; baseline 178.09); kestrel_history_share P (2022 Kestrel order + Gold contract on the VIN -> 0.85; baseline 157.14); program_share P, cross-difficulty purchase (Certified Plus -> 0.9; baseline 148.41).
 Roll-in 947.99 (baseline 1694.75): payoff_accrual_window M (gt passed 5 days -> +2.38x5; baseline 939.78); signing_value_figure M, cross-difficulty finance (signed 9 days before pickup -> value-credited 9875.00 instead of equity 9541.43; baseline 1178.29); term_share P (60 months -> 0.85; baseline 1115.28); standing_share P, multi-source (Tier C score 620 < 640, autopay on -> 0.9; baseline 1053.32); addon_share P (Silver financed, no maintenance plan -> 0.95; baseline 997.89); gap_share P (GAP Standard -> 0.95; baseline 997.89). Tier C ceiling 2500 not reached.
 Shortfall payment 856.80 (baseline 758.66): coverage_quote_choice M (highest 11402.66 vs latest 11236.18, drop 166.48 > 71.40 -> highest; baseline 690.32; near-miss: the latest quote is the one a careless reader uses); coverage_accrual_convention M (2-day validity -> each day after the quote date, 7 days; baseline 852.04); coverage_cushion P (age 7 -> 5 days; baseline 844.90); loyalty_credit_tier P, multi-source, cross-difficulty finance (Kestrel sold the CR-V + autopay -> 60.00; baseline 916.80); protection_credit_tier P, cross-difficulty warranty (Silver -> 25.00; baseline 881.80).
 Payoff charge 11237.37 (baseline 11248.08): payoff_channel_window P, multi-source (11236.18 < 15000, Tuesday -> +1 day, window 6; baseline 11236.18); kestrel_backlog_absorption M (deduction posted 4 days after pickup > 2 -> absorbs 4 days; baseline business-day deadline 2026-09-16 gives 0; 11242.13); quote_refresh_relief P (age 7 -> 1 day; baseline 11238.56); program_per_diem P, cross-difficulty purchase (Certified Plus -> 0.5; baseline 11238.56).
 Every factor moves its result; the all-baseline figure of each computation differs from gold. History floor: zeroing SUM/COUNT/MAX moves every result; cross-category floor: forcing cross reads off moves every result (check_compute OK).

[Overrides declared] mileage: pickup-inspection mileage clause and the title-receipt chargeback timing (for mileage); roll-in: base negative-equity definition and the roll-in limit sentence; shortfall payment: base negative-equity definition; payoff: base amount-sent sentence and the Kestrel-late per-diem sentence. Each replaced_by is a verbatim sentence of the extended rule; base params values stay in force (grade tolerance, per-mile rate, max quote age 10, payoff send business days 3, roll-in allowed, 5 payment days).

[Seed rows and why they exist] Customer ff0901b4-e850-438e-a9d6-b6bdad2bd349; trade agreement and its 4 ledger rows (object of every write; quotes give near-miss and selection); purchase 80549e83-f891-487a-a044-a52d0264c553 (link, program, Kestrel financing) and 4845e7b0-8dc5-44c3-9b16-e03a9dbb85b2 (Kestrel sold the CR-V); finance contract 78a5cf0e-aa79-4d4d-82ae-8209024e85e2 and its funding entry (tier, term, autopay, signing date, ceiling; funding proves the purchase is paid through it); service contract 763acceb-0090-4297-b4ea-6fade6b58fdb with limit, two adjudications and two payments (odometer record, Kestrel-history); service contract 21b2acd4-cbd5-4dc8-a6b3-e8ea3258dc94 with its limit (add-on share, protection credit); GAP waiver ee78f902-73b9-43e5-92c8-d7ab2a95c802 (GAP share); delivery d1887ed0-6d0b-41ee-9995-3b1ca3e06302 (slip credit). Removing any of them moves a figure listed above. No row ignites another obligation: the purchase is delivered with balance 0, the finance contract has its first payment due 2026-10-02, the Gold contract on the traded CR-V is active (its cancellation is the holder's own business in another difficulty and is not raised by the persona).

[Persona design] Renata speaks for herself, plainly and a bit hurried; she volunteers only the surface goal (old loan not paid off, pay it today) and her mobile number; credentials, lender and account number only when asked; she reacts only after the agent speaks (agrees to bookings, explains the mileage, pays exactly the quoted amount with the quoted reference through the handed-over tool, says yes to sending, closes once told the payoff is sent). She never mentions deductions, financing, a shortfall or payments. Her last reaction answers the last gold action.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB, SSN4) -> agreements -> trade ledger -> purchase orders -> delivery -> service contracts -> warranty transactions (by customer) -> finance contract -> finance ledger -> GAP -> maintenance plans (none) -> unlock+call mileage deduction 133.57 -> unlock+call roll-in 947.99 on the Mazda order -> unlock user tool, customer pays 856.80 -> unlock+call payoff 11237.37 on quote 263375. Terminal trade equity 108.85 (Kestrel-absorbed per diem and the coverage cushion, distributed later under the equity rules once the title arrives).

[Verification] Commands: solve.py 0 (printed results 133.57 / 947.99 / 856.80 / 11237.37 and the factor baselines above), edges.py 0 (skip-edge figures above; swap a<->d identical terminal; gold terminal equity 108.85); gates check_extended/check_task_tools/replay_tasks/check_solvability/check_compute/check_grounding/check_cross_fire --task 0 all OK.
